image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a large adult common iguana resting on rough, grey rocks. The iguana has greyish-green skin with darker banding, a prominent dorsal crest of spines running down its neck and back, and a large circular subtympanic shield visible on the side of its head. Its front left limb is clearly visible with clawed digits gripping the rock surface. The background consists of out-of-focus stone textures.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail extends out of the frame immediately behind the hindquarters. While the base is visible, the full length and lateral compression cannot be fully verified due to cropping.
